targets: same x, same positions; no y, no PAD mask

historical_sensitivity.population: entire supplied x; historical pilots used first fixed validation batch
historical_sensitivity.limitation: depends on raw logit offsets/scale and batch latent spread; not mutual information or reconstruction utility

interpretation_limits: Paired deltas are descriptive on this fixed subset, not independent-sample confidence intervals.
Small swap damage plus small TV supports little useful sequence-specific dependence on this population; does not estimate global mutual information.
Zero latent may be off-manifold; low top1 diversity alone cannot establish collapse.
Position marginals can explain position-only behavior without sequence information.
